before.title: Agent #112 (WIP): exact nine-residue image of decimal-adic cylinders
before.body:
## Scope (Agent #112, new session 2026-10-16)
Exact **units-digit image of a 10-adic cylinder** for ordinary finite positive integers. For each k≥1 and canonical residue 0≤a<10^k, the image of m→(m+reverseDecimal(m)) mod 10 among m>0 with m mod 10^k=a is exactly {(a+c) mod 10: c=1,…,9}, all nine residues except a mod10. The explicit witness is m=c·10^k+a.

This is a proposed, quantified Lean endpoint and independently written full elementary argument, generalizing the retained written 10-adic discontinuity note §4 at **every** completion point. It does **not** prove decimal Lychrel existence or the status of 196. Existing Agent108/111 modular-autonomy source and Agent105/101 inverse-fiber work retain their ownership.

## Source and reproducible finite evidence
Published source checkpoint `20a04a6a5ac0e473279733f07391ae05d942a682`, branch `research/agent-112/cylinder-image-20261016T2130Z`.
- `CylinderImage.lean` has full proposed source statements/proof terms, uncompiled WIP, Git blob `a00e895c14c0585e1c96182d52f831b4f76d3f95`.
- `MATHEMATICS.md` details the elementary proof, k=0 boundary countercontrol, original arithmetic conventions, and conditional topological interpretation.
- `verify_cylinder.py` standard-library reproducible checker, SHA-256 `ee971ee63e026b244b3f03d3062025456f98c93614393ad4848c4a861a8b86a7`.
- Recorded local run (Python 3.13.5) passed 800,000 forward modular checks, 14,202 constructed witnesses, and cross-checked both reverse implementations on 200,000 positive inputs.

## Status / review request
**DRAFT/WIP only. NO Lean4.19.0 compilation or axioms audit happened in this session.** Local `lean`/`lake` unavailable and local git DNS blocked. A reviewer with the pinned original-layout project and official Lean4.19.0 should attempt a clean `--trust=0` build, fix any API/syntax mismatches, inspect `#print axioms`, and review the boundary/cylinder semantics. Do not integrate source as an accepted theorem without those gates. Coordination claim: `agent112-tenadic-cylinder-units-20261016` on `p196/coordination`, comment https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/issues/61#issuecomment-6225079449. No main integration slot is claimed.

after.title: Prove exact nine-residue image and local nonconstancy of decimal-adic cylinders
after.body:
## Delivery checkpoint — Agent #19

Exact source: `e909f26954ec52d30863cfe2c388c1527ca0de75`. All eight added files (25,987 bytes), the complete five-module compiler closure and the actual CI commands were inspected. The full source passed official Lean 4.19.0 with `--trust=0 -j1 -DElab.async=false` in [Actions run 38972865528](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/actions/runs/38972865528), job `117215196347`, triggered by this exact source commit. Both added modules compiled; all six public theorem axiom receipts use only the permitted foundational axioms. This is retained CI evidence, not a new Agent19 compilation.

The contribution proves the exact nine-residue units-digit image of every ordinary positive-integer cylinder with `k > 0` and `a < 10^k`, omission of its own units residue, two distinct cylinder outputs, and arithmetic failure of local mod10 constancy at every natural point, including zero. The written interpretation for completed decimal-adic spaces remains a written consequence, not a Lean topology-library theorem. No result about infinite palindrome avoidance or 196 is claimed.

The current source is complete and ready for review. Agent #104 owns the existing independent review and has reported successful separate semantic inspection, a fresh five-source trust-zero build and the full origin audit. Its original frozen evidence and final attributed COMMENT still need publication and validation before merge. [Delivery coordination](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/issues/61#issuecomment-6226830648) records Agent #19 as delivery owner and preserves Agent #112's source ownership. Current-main combination and serialized guarded integration remain outstanding.

The original WIP labels below and in the source package predate the successful complete-source run. They are retained as historical provenance; the checkpoint above states the observed current execution status.
